# Brian K. Fung, PharmD, MPH, CNA

> Clinician-engineer working to connect the world's healthcare data. Founder of haau3, a free app that gathers a loved one's health records in one place for caregivers, and of OpenClinTech, where I teach clinicians to build software. PharmD, MPH, CNA.

This site is the curriculum vitae of Brian K. Fung (handle: briankfung), a residency-trained informatics pharmacist who builds clinical AI products. Not the technology journalist of the same name.

Brian K. Fung contributed to the electronic prescribing sections of the ONC's 21st Century Cures Act Final Rule, modernized enterprise clinical systems across 80 hospitals and clinics at Mayo Clinic, and served as Staff Clinical Informatics Data Architect at Verily. He is now a founder shipping clinical AI products. The largest is haau3, a CMS-recognized caregiving app listed in the CMS Medicare App Library, built on the haau3 platform: six FHIR APIs for scheduling, terminology, provider directory, questionnaires, medication reconciliation, and plan benefits that other builders can use too. As a member of the HL7 SMART Scheduling Links work group, he created and maintains its FHIR implementation guide.

## Selected work

- [haau3](https://haau3.com): caregiving app recognized in the CMS Health Tech Ecosystem and listed in the CMS Medicare App Library
- [haau3 platform](https://platform.haau3.com): six FHIR APIs, in preview, that power haau3 and are open to other builders
- [haau3 FHIR Implementation Guide](https://fhir.haau3.com): profiles, extensions, and operations behind the haau3 app and platform
- [Unscripted Rx](https://www.unscripted-rx.com): modern pharmacy residency directory and recruiting events platform
- [US Pharmacy FHIR Implementation Guide](https://build.fhir.org/ig/unscripted-rx/us-pharmacy-fhir-ig/): work-in-progress FHIR R4 implementation guide for US pharmacy, published by Unscripted Rx and built live on stream
- [Phantom Codes](https://github.com/briankfung/phantom-codes): benchmark of hallucination, accuracy and cost in LLM-based medical concept normalization
- [@briankfung/fhir-types](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@briankfung/fhir-types): hand-rolled HL7 FHIR R4 TypeScript types on npm
- [Public FHIR Server](https://public-fhir-server.vercel.app): FHIR R4 resource operations on Postgres, deployed for learning and reference
